title: Pydantic AI Core Framework
summary: This module encapsulates the foundational components for building, running, and extending AI agents. It provides core abstractions for LLM interaction, agent capabilities, tool management, and essential utilities, forming the backbone of the Pydantic AI ecosystem.

nodes.label: Agent Definition & Execution
nodes.title: Agent Framework Core
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface, configuration, and execution flow for AI agents, enabling structured interaction with LLMs and tools.

nodes.label: Agent Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: Agent Capabilities and Tools
nodes.description: Manages agent functionalities, tool discovery, execution, and structured output mechanisms, extending agent behavior and interaction.

nodes.label: LLM Model Abstraction
nodes.title: LLM Model Abstraction Layer
nodes.description: Provides a unified interface for interacting with various Large Language Models, handling requests, responses, and streaming data efficiently.

nodes.label: Core System Utilities
nodes.title: Pydantic AI Core Utilities
nodes.description: Offers fundamental helper functions, concurrency management, and contextual data for agent operations, supporting the entire framework's infrastructure.

nodes.label: Durable Execution Integrations
nodes.title: Durable Execution Integrations
nodes.description: Enables fault-tolerant and persistent agent execution through integration with external workflow systems like Temporal and Prefect, ensuring reliability.
